prose: Google plans to make it easier to restrict its AI tools for students in early 2027, but schools that block AI entirely will lose student access to Google Search, per the New York Times. The tension is between letting schools manage AI use and Google tying core search access to AI participation.
highlights: Easier AI restrictions for students planned for early 2027
Schools that block AI entirely would lose student Search access, per NYT
basis: Error cache: NYT paywall/bot-block. Written from the Techmeme headline and NYT lede.
